revise_description: To reflect a new energy-saving policy with peak/off-peak tariffs and a maintenance window, batches now must be scheduled on a discrete time grid with vat-specific energy costs per period and limited peak usage. Introduce binary start variables x[batch,vat,time] and binary active indicators y[vat,time]. Each batch must be processed exactly once on each vat with uninterrupted processing. Vats cannot process more than one batch at a time and must respect a maintenance shutdown on Vat 2 in periods 4–5. Energy costs per vat and time are added to the objective weighted by energy_cost_vat_time and peak_energy_multiplier. Total active energy usage in peak periods 6–8 is capped by peak_energy_cap. The objective minimizes a weighted sum: makespan_weight times makespan plus energy_weight times total energy cost.
